response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile hands-on engineer with roughly 15 years of professional experience across web, embedded, high-throughput backend, and open-source work, and he meets the minimum bar on years and a technical bachelor's degree. However, this role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy: it expects recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products or platforms, deep cloud platform fluency, and experience influencing executives, strategic customers, and partners. The resume shows almost none of that — AI exposure is limited to recent MCP/agent tooling at re:cinq, cloud experience is mostly AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployment rather than cloud platform strategy, and the career trajectory is senior/staff IC delivery rather than organizational-level technical influence. The gap between the profile and the seniority/AI-strategy requirements is too wide to justify an interview.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, embedded, and low-latency systems
Founder of an open-source geo-data platform, showing product ownership and entrepreneurial drive
Strong community presence via talks, workshops, courses, and OSS libraries
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products shipped at scale
Career level is senior/staff IC, well below director-level IC scope
Limited cloud platform strategy and customer/partner advisory experience

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and shipped AI products
Breadth of engineering experience and OSS/founder track record
